judge.rationale: The candidate correctly implements the usage accumulation logic and covers the required multi-round and missing-usage scenarios with thorough tests. However, it misses the acceptance criterion requiring the public hook signature (`OrchestratorHooks.afterModelResponse`) to make the aggregation unambiguous (which the reference accomplishes by renaming the parameter from `usage` to `totalUsage`), as even noted by the unchecked facet in its own `.lore/dod.md`. Additionally, the candidate creates three new test files, a separate `turnUsage.ts` module, and commits `.lore/dod.md` and changes to `scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs`, whereas the reference keeps the helper inline in `chatOrchestrator.ts` and adds tests to the existing `chatOrchestrator.test.ts` suite. Finally, in `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, the candidate leaves the new behavior under the 'Measured semantics — out of scope' section instead of moving it to the main specification list and updating `specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md`.
